headline: The outer-pedal area centroid in even-period elliptic billiards
name: The outer-pedal area centroid in even-period elliptic billiards
abstract: Reznik, Garcia and Koiller observed that the area centroid of the outer-side pedal polygon of an even-period elliptic billiard is independent of the orbit phase (invariant k307). We prove this observation on the natural domain of the signed-area centroid and give its explicit value. The proof uses antipodal pairing, support coordinates and telescoping edge moments. For simple even orbits the centroid exists for every fixed pedal point. For even star orbits it can be undefined on a fixed circle, which we determine exactly and realize in a noncircular eight-period example. The note includes a reproducible verification package; the written identities give the all-period proof.
keywords: The outer-pedal area centroid in even-period elliptic billiards; elliptic billiards; Poncelet polygons; pedal polygons; signed area centroid; k307; confocal caustics
